model.description: A parent-with-children's status is the WEAKEST-LINK rollup of its children's DERIVED statuses: the least-advanced child caps the parent (<=In-Progress) — a coordination root can never be past its least-advanced child; children-rollup is AUTHORITATIVE for a parent-with-children (kills the lying stored 'Planned' on coord-root 37.4).
